metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for product work: PRDs, user and market research, sales-call analysis, positioning, PLG, analytics tracking, CRO, design systems, behavioural design, and writing review.

plugins.name: prd-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end PRD pipeline: draft, evaluate gaps, brainstorm real-world situations/behaviours

plugins.name: strategic-research
plugins.description: Research a market in plain language: map what people do, find the segments, estimate what they'd pay, size up competitors, and end with a one-page recommendation. Every fact is sourced; nothing is scored by guesswork. Run end-to-end with /strategic-research or call any step standalone.

plugins.name: pmm-define-and-review-positioning
plugins.description: Product positioning toolkit: guided 10-step workshop, positioning review/audit, competitive alternatives deep dive, market frame selection, and sales story builder. Run end-to-end with positioning-orchestrator or invoke any skill standalone.

plugins.name: user-research
plugins.description: Plan user interviews, analyze each participant's transcript with one sub-agent per participant (what they actually did, pains, goals, barriers, each with verbatim quotes), then synthesize answers to your research questions across participants.

plugins.name: sales-call-analysis
plugins.description: Turn sales call transcripts into pains, outcomes, objections and decision criteria (each with verbatim quotes), what it would take to convert each prospect, and hook messaging. One sub-agent per client, then cross-client roll-up tables.

plugins.name: plg-growth
plugins.description: Product-led growth help for PMs: check PLG fit, find the revenue lever that matters, choose freemium vs trial vs ungated, diagnose acquisition, activation, retention, monetisation and satisfaction, design growth loops and product-led sales, plan experiments, set up data, and restructure the org. Short answers by default, full analysis on request, no invented benchmarks.

plugins.name: event-tracking
plugins.description: Define, review, and format analytics event tracking plans. Three skills: analytics use cases → event definition (with optional formatting for Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, Segment, GA4) → tracking plan review. Every event traces to a use case.

plugins.name: cro-engine
plugins.description: A conversion-rate-optimization reviewer for landing pages, pricing, signup, onboarding, paywalls, popups, and forms. Returns the top few fixes, each tied to a concrete element and a test to run.

plugins.name: design-system-master
plugins.description: Design system master: review an existing design system (accessibility and complexity-fit gates, top fixes, what to keep), optimise one (including inside a real product codebase), or create one from scratch. Grounded in a corpus of 74 real-world design systems spanning minimal dev-tools to dense financial and enterprise systems, so it never naively 'simplifies' complexity a domain legitimately needs. Orchestrated by /design-system-master or invoke review/optimize/create standalone.

plugins.name: designing-for-behaviour
plugins.description: Review how well a product experience — an existing codebase or an idea/PRD — drives user behaviour, adoption, and engagement. Four behavioural-science lenses find anchored gaps; an anti-bloat coherence review and ethics gate turn them into at most three sequenced core moves plus a 'deliberately NOT adding' list, in a two-page report with no invented score. Run with /designing-for-behaviour.

plugins.name: user-story-review
plugins.description: User story reviewer: reads a PRD or backlog and returns a one-page triage — the few systemic issues that will sink the milestone, a verdict per story (ready / needs conversation / reframe / split / not a user story), and rewrites for the worst offenders. Judges whether a story is true and useful rather than whether it matches the template: catches feature requests wearing story clothes, generic actors, fake value, technical layers sliced as stories, and outcomes outside the team's control. Grounded in Fifty Quick Ideas to Improve Your User Stories. Run with /user-story-review.

plugins.name: writing-review
plugins.description: Review a draft like a linter, not an editor. Five narrow reviewers (reader, structure, argument, evidence, prose) run in parallel as independent sub-agents; every finding is an exact quote, the problem it causes, and the smallest fix. Merged into one ranked review. The prose reviewer checks Zinsser-style clutter and AI-writing tells. Run with /writing-review:review-writing.
